## About
Rafie Restu Ramadhani is a forward-thinking developer and technology innovator based in Tangerang, Indonesia. He is an Information System student at Gunadarma University, Founder & CEO at Meluna, and an active member of GDGoC @ Gunadarma University.

## Core Technical Skills
- **Languages & Frameworks:** JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, Express.js, Expo, PHP, Laravel, Python, Fastify, TailwindCSS, shadcn/ui.
- **AI & Systems:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), Agentic Workforces, MQTT IoT Brokers, REST APIs.
- **Databases & Cloud:** SQLite, Azure.
- **Tools & Workflow:** Figma, VS Code, Antigravity, Claude Code, Cursor, Remotion, Canva, Capcut.

## Featured Projects
- **LiteSpeak:** Zero-setup, open-source IoT platform combining MQTT Broker, REST API, and native AI (MCP) integration. ([GitHub](https://github.com/rpiirmdhni/LiteSpeak))
- **ECOTRA:** IoT and AI-based smart agriculture system to monitor chili plant conditions and detect diseases via mobile app (PKM-KC).
- **Nineteen Million (AI) Jobs (NMJ):** Open-source dashboard for creating, configuring, and managing hierarchical AI agent workforces. ([GitHub](https://github.com/rpiirmdhni/nmj))
- **My Gunadarma:** Laravel-based academic web application featuring QR code attendance and e-library. ([GitHub](https://github.com/rpiirmdhni/my-gunadarma))
